title: NNSA officials attend Sol Foundation UFO conference

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that at a gathering of the Sol Foundation, a group at Stanford University devoted to UFO research, people from the National Nuclear Security Administration showed up. That agency is the part of the US government that looks after the country's nuclear weapons. Michels tells it as a sign that nuclear officials quietly take the UFO subject seriously.
